projects.title: Ticketora
projects.description: Ticketora is a modern online ticket booking platform that allows users to discover and book travel tickets, manage their bookings, and securely complete payments through an easy-to-use platform.

details.overview: Ticketora is a full-stack online ticket booking platform designed to simplify the process of discovering, booking, and managing travel tickets. Users can browse available tickets, view travel details, submit booking requests, and complete secure payments after booking approval. The platform includes separate user, vendor, and admin workflows for managing tickets, bookings, approvals, and advertisements.
features: Bus, train, and flight ticket support

projects.title: Tutor Booking System
projects.description: A modern online tutoring platform that connects students with qualified tutors, allowing users to find tutors, book learning sessions, and manage their personalized learning experience.

details.overview: Tutor Booking System is a modern online tutoring platform designed to connect students with qualified tutors for personalized learning experiences. Students can browse tutors based on their subjects and requirements, schedule tutoring sessions, and manage their learning journey through a user-friendly platform. The system also provides flexible scheduling, tutor verification, progress tracking, communication features, and secure payment options.

projects.title: NextGen Edu
projects.description: NextGen Edu is a modern AI-powered learning platform where students can explore courses, track their learning progress, and enjoy a smooth and interactive educational experience.

details.overview: NextGen Edu is an AI-powered learning platform designed to make online education more interactive, accessible, and engaging. The platform provides students with a clean learning environment where they can explore courses, manage their learning activities, and track their progress.

projects.title: Keen Keeper
projects.description: Keen Keeper is a modern productivity and task management platform designed to help users organize daily work, track progress, and manage tasks efficiently.

details.overview: Keen Keeper is a productivity-focused task management platform built to help users organize their daily activities and maintain better control over their work. It provides a clean and intuitive interface for creating, managing, and tracking tasks.

projects.title: GitHub Issue Tracker
projects.description: A clean and efficient GitHub Issue Tracker application built to manage, track, and organize project issues with a modern and user-friendly interface.

details.overview: GitHub Issue Tracker is a web application designed to simplify the process of managing and tracking software project issues. It helps developers organize issues, monitor their status, and maintain a more efficient development workflow.

projects.title: Countries
projects.description: A modern country information web application designed to provide useful information about countries through a clean, responsive, and user-friendly interface.

details.overview: Countries is a web application that allows users to explore information about different countries in an interactive and visually appealing way. The project focuses on API integration, responsive design, and creating a smooth browsing experience.

projects.title: TechWave
projects.description: A modern tech-focused web application built with a clean UI and responsive design, showcasing modern frontend development practices and interactive web features.

details.overview: TechWave is a modern technology-focused web application created to demonstrate responsive frontend development and interactive web experiences. The project combines a clean visual design with API integration and data visualization.

projects.title: Job Tracker
projects.description: A modern and responsive Job Tracker web application designed to help users manage and track their job applications efficiently.

details.overview: Job Tracker is a modern application management platform designed to help job seekers organize and monitor their job applications. Users can keep track of application progress, manage important information, and maintain an organized job-search workflow.
